scoringRules.description: Each standard item has weight; multi-indicator items count each indicator; score earned if standard exists/meets criteria; section subtotals; grand total as percentage.

facilityTools.title: A. Self-Evaluation Tool for Daycare Facilities (Creches)

sections.title: 1. Care and Support before birth/ Kwita ku mwana mbere y’uko avuka
2. Food and Nutrition practices
4. Responsive care and support services to children from birth to 3 years/ Kwita ku bana bavutse kugeza ku myaka 3
5. Day-care staffing/ Abakozi b’Irerero
6. Physical Environment/ Imiterere y’Irerero
7. Sanitary Facilities/ Ibikoresho by’Isuku mu Irerero
8. Handwashing practices/ Gukaraba Intoki
9. Building specifications/ Ibisabwa ku Nyubako
10. Equipment/Ibikoresho
11. Breastfeeding Room/ Icyumba cyo konkerezamo
12. Care, learning and play/ Kwitabwaho, Kwiga no Gukina
13. Health/ Ubuzima
14. Child safety and protection/ Umutekano no kurinda umwana ihohoterwa.
15. Positive discipline/ Gukosora umwana utamuhutaje
16. Record Keeping/ Kubika Amakuru ku Bana
17. Education/ Uburezi

facilityTools.title: B. Self-Evaluation Tool for Home-Based ECD Facilities

sections.title: 1. Information about establishment/Imiterere y’urugo mbonezamikurire
2. Information about Leadership and Management/Imiyoborere y’urugo mbonezamikurire
3. Information about Curriculum and Learning Approaches /Integanyanyigisho n’imyigire mu rugo mbonezamikurire.
4. Information about Health/Ubuzima
5. Information about Nutrition/Imirire mu rugo mbonezamikurire
6. Information about Child Protection and Safety/Umutekano no kurinda umwana
7. Information about WASH/Amazi, Isuku n’Isukura
8. Information about Recruitment/Selection and qualification of caregivers /Uko abarezi bashyirwaho mu rugo mbonezamikurire n’impamyabushobozi zabo.

facilityTools.title: C. ECD Mapping Tool for Community-Based ECD Facilities

sections.title: 1. Information about Geographical Location/Aho urugo rukorera
2. Information about Physical Environment/Imiterere y’aho urugo rukorera
3. Information about Classroom/Indoor space/Ibyumba byigirwamo
4. Information about Kitchen/Igikoni
5. Information about Toilets/Ubwiherero
6. Information about Outdoor Play area and Equipment/Aho abana bakinira hanze n’ibikoresho by’imikino.
7. Information about Health Practices and Procedures/Ubuzima
8. Information about Food and Nutrition Practices/Imirire
9. Information about child protection and safety Practices /Umutekano no kurinda umwana.
10. Information about WASH Practices/Amazi, Isuku n’Isukura
11. Information about Organisation of Teaching and Learning Activities/Play activities/Kuyobora ibikorwa by’imyigire n’imyigishirize.

13. Information about Establishment, Registration and Accreditation/ Gutangiza no kwandikisha urugo mbonezamikurire

15. Information about Recruitment and qualification of caregivers/Ishyirwa mu kazi ku barezi mu rugo mbonezamikurire rukorera muri kominote mu mudugudu.
